steps: Preparing the fish (tilapia) and macaxeira (yam/cassava) with vinegar, water, oil, and salt.
Cooking the dish, emphasizing the use of coriander for flavor.
Serving the meal to family members (father and Maicon).

viewers.closing_message: Thanks to everyone who watches the video. May God bless your lives. See you in the next video. Hugs to all of you. Goodbye, everyone. Until next time!

video_structure.opening: Cooking demonstration with a focus on the dish's preparation.
video_structure.middle: Highlighting the ingredients and cooking steps, followed by serving the meal to family.
video_structure.closing: Gratitude to viewers, encouragement to like the video, and a farewell.

additional_notes.target_audience: Home cooks, food enthusiasts, and viewers interested in Brazilian cuisine.
